_comment: Discriminative solver-catches campaign (redesign of the non-discriminative 007/008). Experiment 009 (transfer-conservation, map[int,int]) and 010 (byte-saturate, bytes[8]). Both replace an obvious correct fill with a task carrying a PLAUSIBLE subtle-error surface: 009's correct fill debits one account and credits another (straight-line double put); the plausible error is crediting the destination but forgetting to debit the source, which breaks the withheld conservation post. 010's correct fill is a saturating add (clamp at 255); the plausible error is adding without the saturation clamp, which overflows the withheld <=255 ceiling on a high byte. In BOTH the visible non-adversarial check samples values where the correct and wrong fills agree (transfer keeps accounts present; brighten on the all-zero buffer stays small), so a wrong fill passes it (tests blind) and only the solver catches the bug. Per-cell metric unchanged: solver_caught = (test PASS) AND (verify REFUTED on the withheld post). Grade A = refuted (solver caught the subtle bug), B = verified-clean (correct fill), C = vacuous, F = non-compile/missing-check. HYPOTHESIS (revised after the 006/007/008 run returned 24/24 grade B — those tasks were too easy): with a plausible error surface, a non-trivial fraction of fills across models are subtly wrong and caught by the solver (grade A), yielding a real A/B split. NULL = still all-B (even the harder tasks are one-shot for these models) or all-C (VC never reaches the array class). run_count=5. 2 experiments x 3 models x 5 tries = 30 attempts. NOTE: 006/007/008 already have partial all-B data from batch 20260723T224420Z (opus 15/15 B, gpt-5.5 9/9 B, gemini unrun); those trivial fixtures are not re-run here. Add "006" to experiments if a fresh baseline anchor is wanted.
_feasibility_gate: REQUIRES llmll >= 0.14.63 on the PATH the harness resolves (confirmed 0.14.63 at authoring; the map/bytes PBT test-path evaluator landed v0.14.63). Discriminative-pair spot-check done on the fixed binary before wiring: 009 correct (debit+credit) -> visible test PASS + injected-conservation-post verify SAFE body-faithful = B; 009 wrong (forgot debit) -> test PASS + verify REFUTED = A; 010 correct (saturating add) -> test PASS + verify SAFE = B; 010 wrong (no clamp) -> test PASS + verify REFUTED = A. COMPILER LIMITATION surfaced during design (routed to compiler-engineer): a conditional (if) in a MAP-store body — whether the if is map-valued or the stored value is an if — falls back from body-faithful verification, so 009's correct fill is kept straight-line (an int-returning if-clamp like 010's brighten is fine). Before the billed run: (1) confirm `llmll version` == 0.14.63 on PATH; (2) run_matrix.py --prepare-only and confirm grading_mode=solver_catches, scaffold provided, hidden-specs/009.json+010.json NOT copied into any agent-visible dir, no underscore-prefixed key survives.
